about: Whether a thread keeps that its root was ever a contact, as the root's contact row comes and goes (HDTP 9.2, SEP-0004). One list, run by name on the node (store conformance, KeptWasContactCases) and on BatonDeck (test/kept-was-contact.test.ts, which reads this file from the node checkout). Steps: active, blocked, pending_in and pending_out insert a row in that status when the root has none, and active or blocked move a held row; removed deletes the row; expired deletes every request past its time.

cases.name: a contact blocked after being one, then removed
a former contact who asks again and expires
added again after removal and removed again
